input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Response.__init__ reads self.raw.reason to initialize reason, but raw has no underlying response object yet at construction time, so the attribute access dereferences None.
- failure path: Any call that builds a Response, such as every adapter.send or a plain Response(), raises AttributeError ('NoneType' object has no attribute 'reason') before the object is populated, so no request can complete.

Reviewer finding
- description: Response.__init__ now reads self.raw.reason, but self.raw is not set at that point in __init__ and defaults to None. Adapter.build_response sets resp.raw after construction. Also, Response() created directly has raw=None.
- rationale: Trigger: any `Response()` construction, including the one in HTTPAdapter.build_response, or in tests/mocks. In requests, `self.raw = None` is set later in __init__, so it either raises AttributeError (if raw not yet defined) or, if defined as None, raises AttributeError 'NoneType has no attribute reason'. Impact: every request crashes, and the later assignment of reason in the adapter becomes redundant.
critique: The finding identifies the same faulty operation: Response.__init__ reads self.raw.reason while raw is None or not yet set. It also gives the same failure, an AttributeError on every Response construction, including the one in adapter build_response, so all requests fail.
